## v0.5.28: Git sync usability and reliability / Git 同步体验与可靠性

Publishes [#365](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/365), [#366](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/366) and [#363](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/363).

- Git sync follows connect → sync → compare → advanced settings, with clear errors, backup history, custom computer names and a disconnect action. Repository switches no longer carry another repository's history; concurrent pushes, repeated merges and abandoned locks are handled safely. Git sync remains off by default.
- The Memory System's top band and title row participate in macOS Desktop window dragging.
- RetainDB uses legacy endpoints only for HTTP 404, avoiding duplicate writes after an ambiguous failure.

发布 [#365](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/365)、[#366](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/366) 与 [#363](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/363)。

- Git 同步按连接 → 同步 → 比较 → 高级设置组织，提供清晰错误、备份历史、自定义电脑名称与断开连接。切换仓库不再携带上一仓库的历史，并处理并发推送、重复合并与遗留锁。Git 同步仍默认关闭。
- macOS Desktop 中记忆系统的顶部留白与标题行可用于拖动窗口。
- RetainDB 仅在 HTTP 404 时回退旧接口，避免在不明确的失败后重复写入。

The Starter advances to **0.5.28** and RetainDB to **0.5.6**. The other 16 component versions are unchanged. Existing memory needs no migration.

Starter 升至 **0.5.28**，RetainDB 升至 **0.5.6**；其余 16 个组件版本不变，无需迁移已有记忆。

Use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH, or install the exact version:

使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.28
```

An independently maintained RetainDB copy in the Profile also needs `dsh-mnemon-provider-retaindb@0.5.6`.

Profile 独立维护的 RetainDB 副本也需更新到 `dsh-mnemon-provider-retaindb@0.5.6`。
